_note: Fictional data only. No production IDs. IDs below are deterministic UUIDs chosen for readability in this fixture pack (traceable prefix per entity type) — they do not exist in any real environment. tenant_id/department_id/user_id are NOT hard-coded here: this pack is designed to be loaded against a freshly-onboarded demo tenant (see README.md/curl_examples.sh). projects._note: No 'projects' table/entity exists anywhere in the current schema (confirmed by inspection — gateway/src/Aiq.Gateway/Data/Migrations/*.sql has no sim_projects or projects table). The business process document itself only ever uses a project code as a free-text tag inside an expense claim's item description (worked example: 'Công tác Hà Nội 20-22/08/2026 · Dự án PRJ-014'). This list is a lightweight REFERENCE list for tagging luong03 expense item descriptions consistently — not a DB-backed entity, and no new column/table was invented for it.

employees._note: sim_employees is not one of the explicitly-requested master-data categories, but Luồng 03 (expense claims) structurally requires an employee_code that resolves via sim_employees — these are the minimum fixture employees needed to exercise every luong03 case, using only existing columns (employee_code, full_name, department, position, monthly_expense_budget, outstanding_advance — gateway/src/Aiq.Gateway/Data/Migrations/020_simulator_business_schema.sql).

expense_policies._note: department_expense_policies rows needed to make the luong03 policy-cap/rank/journal-routing cases deterministic. category=NULL or position=NULL means 'applies to every category/position' (existing wildcard convention — see gateway/src/Aiq.Gateway/Employees/IExpenseClaimRepository.cs FindPolicyAsync). debit_account/position columns are real (migrations 040, 044).
